title: Animated backgrounds
key.explain: This needs a free Pixabay API key. Create a free account on pixabay.com, then open pixabay.com/api/docs while signed in: your key is shown under Parameters (key). Paste it here. It is stored in ~/.local/state/livewall/pixabay.key, readable only by you.
search.placeholder: Search: ocean, forest, rain, clouds, city at night…
footer.hint: Click: download and set · right-click: download only
error.bad_key_format: That doesn't look like a valid key: copy all of it, without spaces.
error.key_rejected: %1 rejected the key. Paste it again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests: try again in a few minutes.
error.server_error: The server answered with an error (%1).
error.no_mp4: This video has no usable MP4 file.
error.not_mp4: The downloaded file is not an MP4.
